description: Flat record-level metadata schema for fecal shotgun or amplicon sequencing samples from mammalian gut microbiota, designed to capture host, environmental, collection, and sequencing context for comparative microbiome studies.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual sample/record.

biosample_id.descr: External biosample accession or repository identifier, if available.

host_common_name.descr: Common name of the mammalian host (e.g., human, mouse, cow, rhesus macaque).

host_scientific_name.descr: Latin binomial or trinomial name of the host species/subspecies.

host_taxonomy.descr: Higher-level host taxonomy if recorded, such as order or family; use a standardized string if multiple ranks are included.

host_order.descr: Taxonomic order of the host (e.g., Rodentia, Primates, Carnivora, Artiodactyla).

host_sex.descr: Biological sex of the host; acceptable values include male, female, unknown.

host_age_value.descr: Age of the host in the unit specified by host_age_unit.

host_age_unit.descr: Unit for host age (e.g., days, months, years).

host_life_stage.descr: Developmental/life stage of the host (e.g., juvenile, adult, subadult, neonatal, elderly).

host_body_mass_kg.descr: Host body mass in kilograms at or near time of sampling, if available.

host_health_status.descr: Overall health status of the host at sampling; examples include healthy, diseased, subclinical, recovering, unknown.

host_disease_condition.descr: Specific diagnosed condition if health status is not healthy; use a controlled term or clinical label when applicable.

antibiotic_use_recent.descr: Whether the host received antibiotics within a defined recent window before sampling.

recent_antibiotic_window_days.descr: Number of days defining the recent antibiotic exposure window, if recorded.

diet_type.descr: Primary diet category of the host; examples include herbivore, carnivore, omnivore, omnivorous, grazing, browsing, mixed diet.

diet_detail.descr: More detailed diet description, feed formulation, or food items if available.

captive_status.descr: Whether the host was wild, captive, farmed, zoo-held, domestic, or otherwise managed.

host_living_setting.descr: Broader living setting such as wild, household, farm, zoo, laboratory, sanctuary.

sample_type.descr: Biological material collected; for this study typically feces or stool.

sample_matrix.descr: Matrix or specimen subtype if relevant, such as fecal pellet, fresh feces, rectal swab, stool.

sample_collection_date.descr: Date the sample was collected in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

sample_collection_time.descr: Time of sample collection if available, in local time or ISO 8601 time format stored as string.

collection_method.descr: Method used to obtain the sample (e.g., fresh collection, swab, trapping, opportunistic collection).

collection_environment.descr: Immediate environment where the sample was collected (e.g., field, enclosure, barn, household, clinic).

geographic_country.descr: Country of sample collection or host origin.

geographic_region.descr: Administrative region, province, state, or equivalent locality.

geographic_locality.descr: More specific locality such as city, village, park, ranch, or site name.

latitude.descr: Sampling location latitude in decimal degrees, WGS84.

longitude.descr: Sampling location longitude in decimal degrees, WGS84.

elevation_m.descr: Elevation of the sampling location in meters above sea level, if known.

climate_zone.descr: Optional climate classification of the sampling location (e.g., tropical, temperate, arid, polar, or Köppen class).

cohort_id.descr: Identifier linking samples from the same study cohort, host population, or site group.

household_or_farm_id.descr: Identifier for household, farm, enclosure, or managed group if relevant and permitted.

sample_storage_temperature_c.descr: Temperature at which the sample was stored after collection, in degrees Celsius.

storage_duration_hours.descr: Time between collection and stabilization/freezing, in hours.

preservative_used.descr: Whether a preservation reagent was used, such as ethanol, RNAlater, or DNA stabilization buffer.

preservative_type.descr: Type/name of preservative used, if applicable.

dna_extraction_kit.descr: Name and model of DNA extraction kit or protocol used.

dna_extraction_method.descr: Brief description of extraction workflow, including bead beating or enzymatic lysis if relevant.

library_prep_protocol.descr: Library preparation protocol or kit used before sequencing.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used (e.g., Illumina NovaSeq, MiSeq, NextSeq, Oxford Nanopore).

sequencing_strategy.descr: Sequencing strategy, such as shotgun metagenomics, 16S rRNA amplicon, or other targeted metagenomics.

read_layout.descr: Read layout such as single-end, paired-end, or long-read.

read_length_bp.descr: Nominal read length in base pairs for short-read data, if applicable.

library_insert_size_bp.descr: Expected insert size in base pairs, if applicable.

sequencing_depth_reads.descr: Total number of reads generated for the sample.

quality_control_passed.descr: Whether the sample passed post-sequencing quality control criteria.

qc_notes.descr: Free-text notes on QC outcomes, contamination concerns, exclusions, or special handling.

bioinformatic_pipeline.descr: Name and version of the primary analysis pipeline used to process reads.

reference_database.descr: Reference database used for taxonomic or functional annotation, if applicable.

functional_annotation_method.descr: Method used to infer functional capabilities (e.g., HUMAnN, KEGG mapping, eggNOG, gene family profiling).

taxonomic_assignment_method.descr: Method or classifier used for taxonomic profiling, if applicable.

notes.descr: Additional sample-level notes not captured by other fields.
